messages:
sarah: Following the billing incident on 2026-03-12 — we need clear owners and ETAs for the remaining remediation work: token recount, delayed-usage backfill, and invoice corrections/messaging. Who can own which pieces? cc @mike @arjun

mike: I can own the token recount + delta validation. Will run a dry-run recount job tonight and share results. ETA for full apply: EOD 2026-03-16 (if dry-run looks clean).

arjun: I can own the backfill pipeline and monitoring during the run. Plan is a canary run then scale. Tentative backfill window 03:00–05:00 UTC on 2026-03-16. Need Leah to merge the ingest schema patch first.

leah: I will push the schema patch today and target merge by 2026-03-15 12:00 UTC. PR: https://github.com/redwood/ingest/pull/4523 — tests currently passing in CI.

billing-bot: Created task BI-789: token-recount-dryrun, assigned to mike, due 2026-03-15.

sarah: Thanks. Mike, can you paste the recount commands + guardrails we should use? Finance needs the token-delta format so we can compute credits. Also confirm safety steps to avoid duplicate charges.

mike: Sure — dry-run then apply. Guardrails: run with --dryrun, validate sample accounts, verify no duplicate ingest writes.

```
# dry run
python tools/recount_tokens.py --mode dryrun --start 2026-03-10 --end 2026-03-12 --out /tmp/recount.csv
# sample validation
python tools/validate_recount.py --csv /tmp/recount.csv --sample 5
# real run (only after sign-off)
python tools/recount_tokens.py --mode apply --confirm --out s3://redwood-backfill/recount-3333.csv
```

arjun: For the backfill I'll do a 5-account canary first (heavy-usage customers). Canary run will be monitored for latency and duplicate events. Rollback: stop pipeline + run dedupe job if we see duplicates. I'll add explicit rollback steps to the runbook.

sarah: Invoice handling: I'll own the reissue/credit plan and messaging. Target: issue credits within 48h after recount completes and Finance sign-off. Mike — please confirm CSV delta columns so we can automate credits.

mike: token delta CSV format: account_id, expected_tokens, ingested_tokens, delta, reason_code
Example row:
acct_12345, 120000, 115000, -5000, delayed_ingest_v2

leah: PR link again: https://github.com/redwood/ingest/pull/4523 — I left a migration note in the PR description about the timestamp normalization change. No downtime expected, just a rolling restart of the ingest workers.

arjun: Confirming schedule — backfill (canary -> full) 2026-03-16 03:00–05:00 UTC. Will post the detailed runbook to Confluence after Leah's PR merges and after Mike's dry-run results.

sarah: Action summary (please ack):
1) Token recount & delta validation — owner: mike — dry-run tonight, apply if clean — target apply by EOD 2026-03-16.
2) Ingest schema patch & migration — owner: leah — merge by 2026-03-15 12:00 UTC (PR #4523).
3) Delayed-usage backfill & monitoring — owner: arjun — canary then full on 2026-03-16 03:00–05:00 UTC.
4) Invoice reissue / credits + customer comms — owner: sarah (Finance) — issue credits within 48h after recount + Finance sign-off.

Please reply with a one-line ack and any blockers.

mike: :thumbsup: ack. Will post dry-run CSV link after job finishes tonight.

arjun: ack — will draft runbook and include rollback steps, will ping in this thread when posted.

leah: ack — PR merged once CI green, will post deploy window.

billing-bot: Task BI-790 created: invoice-credit-draft, assigned to sarah, due 2026-03-18.

sarah: Thanks all — I'll coordinate the customer messaging templates after I see Mike's delta CSV. I'll update the incident follow-up board and close BI-789/BI-790 when done.

(locked for audit)
